
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr><td class="t_f" id="postmessage_55129525">
{标记最近10日}<br>
DRAWICON(V=CONST(REF(V,9)),1,22);STICKLINE(V=CONST(REF(V,9)),0,0.9,0.5,0),COLORFFFFFF;<br>
DRAWNUMBER(V=CONST(REF(V,8)),1,9);<br>
DRAWNUMBER(V=CONST(REF(V,7)),1,8);<br>
DRAWNUMBER(V=CONST(REF(V,6)),1,7);<br>
DRAWNUMBER(V=CONST(REF(V,5)),1,6);<br>
DRAWNUMBER(V=CONST(REF(V,4)),1,5);<br>
DRAWNUMBER(V=CONST(REF(V,3)),1,4);<br>
DRAWNUMBER(V=CONST(REF(V,2)),1,3);<br>
DRAWNUMBER(V=CONST(REF(V,1)),1,2);<br>
DRAWNUMBER(V=CONST(REF(V,0)),1,1);<br>
{计算10日、30日涨幅停牌}<br>
距10日停牌需涨:=100-(C-REF(C,9))/REF(C,9)*100,NODRAW;<br>
距30日停牌需涨:=200-(C-REF(C,29))/REF(C,29)*100,NODRAW;<br>
DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR AND 距10日停牌需涨&gt;=20,0.00,0.06,0,STRCAT('距10日停牌还需涨幅：',STRCAT(CON2STR(距10日停牌需涨,2),' %'))),COLORWHITE;<br>
DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR AND 距10日停牌需涨&lt;20,0.00,0.06,0,STRCAT('距10日停牌还需涨幅：',STRCAT(CON2STR(距10日停牌需涨,2),' %'))),COLORGREEN;<br>
DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR AND 距30日停牌需涨&gt;=20,0.00,0.26,0,STRCAT('距30日停牌还需涨幅：',STRCAT(CON2STR(距30日停牌需涨,2),' %'))),COLORWHITE;<br>
DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR AND 距30日停牌需涨&lt;20,0.00,0.26,0,STRCAT('距30日停牌还需涨幅：',STRCAT(CON2STR(距30日停牌需涨,2),' %'))),COLORGREEN;<br>
{计算异动}<br>
个股0:=C;<br>
个股1:=REF(C,1);<br>
个股2:=REF(C,2);<br>
个股3:=REF(C,3);<br>
标指0:=IF(CODELIKE('00'),"399107$C",IF(CODELIKE('60'),"999998$C",IF(CODELIKE('30'),"399102$C",IF(CODELIKE('68'),"000688$C",0))));<br>
标指1:=REF(标指0, 1);<br>
标指2:=REF(标指0, 2);<br>
标指3:=REF(标指0, 3);<br>
S1:=IF((((个股0/个股2)-1)*100-((标指0/标指2)-1)*100)&gt;20,2,0),;<br>
S2:=IF((((个股0/个股3)-1)*100-((标指0/标指3)-1)*100)&gt;20,3,0),;<br>
S21:=IF(S1=2 OR S2=3,1,0);<br>
S22:=IF(S1+S2=5,1,IF(S2=3,2,1));<br>
A1:=S21 AND REF(S21,1)=0 AND REF(S21,2)=0;<br>
STICKLINE(A1,0,0.5,3,0),COLORMAGENTA;<br>
A2:=BARSLAST(A1),NODRAW;<br>
A21:=S21 AND REF(A1,1)=0 AND REF(A1,S22)=0;<br>
A22:=A21 AND REF(A21,1)=0 AND REF(A21,S22)=0;<br>
STICKLINE(A22,0,0.5,3,0),COLORMAGENTA;<br>
A3:=BARSLAST(A22),NODRAW;<br>
A31:=S21 AND REF(A22,1)=0 AND REF(A22,S22)=0;<br>
A32:=A31 AND REF(A31,1)=0 AND REF(A31,S22)=0;<br>
STICKLINE(A32,0,0.5,3,0),COLORMAGENTA;<br>
A4:=BARSLAST(A32),NODRAW;<br>
A41:=S21 AND REF(A32,1)=0 AND REF(A32,S22)=0;<br>
A42:=A41 AND REF(A41,1)=0 AND REF(A41,S22)=0;<br>
STICKLINE(A42,0,0.5,3,0),COLORMAGENTA;<br>
A5:=BARSLAST(A42),NODRAW;<br>
A51:=S21 AND REF(A42,1)=0 AND REF(A42,S22)=0;<br>
A52:=A51 AND REF(A51,1)=0 AND REF(A51,S22)=0;<br>
STICKLINE(A52,0,0.5,3,0),COLORMAGENTA;<br>
{今日涨幅界限}<br>
今一日涨幅界限:=(((20+((标指0/标指1)-1)*100)/100+1)*个股1/个股1-1)*100,COLORMAGENTA,NODRAW;<br>
今两日涨幅界限:=(((20+((标指0/标指2)-1)*100)/100+1)*个股2/个股1-1)*100,COLORMAGENTA,NODRAW;<br>
今三日涨幅界限:=(((20+((标指0/标指3)-1)*100)/100+1)*个股3/个股1-1)*100,COLORMAGENTA,NODRAW;<br>
{<br>
今一日涨幅界限:20-((个股0/个股1)-1)*100-((标指0/标指1)-1)*100+((个股0/个股1)-1)*100+((标指0/标指1)-1)*100,COLORMAGENTA,NODRAW;<br>
今两日涨幅界限:20-((个股0/个股2)-1)*100-((标指0/标指2)-1)*100+((个股1/个股2)-1)*100+((标指1/标指2)-1)*100,COLORMAGENTA,NODRAW;<br>
今三日涨幅界限:20-((个股0/个股3)-1)*100-((标指0/标指3)-1)*100+((个股1/个股3)-1)*100+((标指1/标指3)-1)*100,COLORMAGENTA,NODRAW;<br>
}<br>
B:=IF(今两日涨幅界限-今三日涨幅界限&gt;0,今三日涨幅界限,今两日涨幅界限);<br>
B1:=IF(A2=1 OR A3=1 OR A4=1 OR BARSLAST(A42)=1,今一日涨幅界限,0),NODRAW;<br>
B2:=IF(A2=2 OR A3=2 OR A4=2 OR BARSLAST(A42)=2,今两日涨幅界限,0),NODRAW;<br>
今异动涨幅界限:IF(B1,B1,IF(B2,B2,B)),NODRAW;<br>
DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR AND 今异动涨幅界限&gt;10,0.20,0.06,0,STRCAT('今涨幅异动界限：',STRCAT(CON2STR(今异动涨幅界限,2),' %')))COLORWHITE;<br>
DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR AND 今异动涨幅界限&lt;=10,0.20,0.06,0,STRCAT('今涨幅异动界限：',STRCAT(CON2STR(今异动涨幅界限,2),' %')))COLORGREEN;<br>
{明日涨停是否会触发异动}<br>
明一日涨幅异动:=((ZTPRICE(C,0.1)/REF(C,0))-1)*100-((标指0/标指0)-1)*100,NODRAW;<br>
明两日涨幅异动:=((ZTPRICE(C,0.1)/REF(C,1))-1)*100-((标指0/标指1)-1)*100,NODRAW;<br>
明三日涨幅异动:=((ZTPRICE(C,0.1)/REF(C,2))-1)*100-((标指0/标指2)-1)*100,NODRAW;<br>
B3:=IF(明两日涨幅异动-明三日涨幅异动&gt;0,明两日涨幅异动,明三日涨幅异动),NODRAW;<br>
B4:=IF(A1 OR A22 OR A32 OR A42,1,0),NODRAW;<br>
B5:=IF(A2=1 OR A3=1 OR A4=1 OR BARSLAST(A42)=1,今两日涨幅界限,0),NODRAW;<br>
B6:=IF(B4,B4,IF(B5,B5,B3)),NODRAW;<br>
明涨停是否异动:=IF(B6&gt;19.9,1,0);<br>
DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR AND 明涨停是否异动=0,0.20,0.26,0,STRCAT('明涨停是否异动：','否')),COLORWHITE;<br>
DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR AND 明涨停是否异动=1,0.20,0.26,0,STRCAT('明涨停是否异动：','是')),COLORGREEN;<br>
{今日涨幅}<br>
今涨幅:=(C/REF(C,1)-1)*100;<br>
DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR AND 今涨幅&gt;0,0.40,0.26,0,STRCAT('今涨幅：：',STRCAT(CON2STR(今涨幅,2),' %'))),COLORFF00FF;<br>
DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR AND 今涨幅&lt;=0,0.40,0.26,0,STRCAT('今涨幅：：',STRCAT(CON2STR(今涨幅,2),' %'))),COLOR00FF00;<br>
{十日内异动次数}<br>
十日内异动次数:=COUNT(A1 OR A22 OR A32 OR A42,10);<br>
DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR AND 十日内异动次数=0,0.40,0.06,0,STRCAT('十日内异动次数：',STRCAT(CON2STR(十日内异动次数,0),' 次')))COLORWHITE;<br>
DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR AND 十日内异动次数&gt;0,0.40,0.06,0,STRCAT('十日内异动次数：',STRCAT(CON2STR(十日内异动次数,0),' 次')))COLORGREEN;</td></tr></tbody></table>
